title: A signed-in keycloak caller lists their project sessions, revokes one, and revokes all others
asA: operator signed in through a Keycloak realm on two browsers
iWant: the account surface to show me every active project session, let me terminate one, and let me terminate every one except the current in a single call
soThat: I end a forgotten or stolen session without touching the realm's admin surface

acceptanceCriteria.description: A `list()` call from an authenticated caller returns one row per active project session, each row carrying `sessionId`, `deviceLabel`, `lastActive`, and `currentSession`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a caller with two active project sessions S1 (current) and S2 in realm `alpha`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the return is exactly two rows shaped per the ownerRef interface, one with `currentSession=true` for S1 and one with `currentSession=false` for S2

acceptanceCriteria.description: `revoke(sessionId)` on a non-current project session invalidates it in the project session store; a replay from the revoked browser is treated as unauthenticated.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the current browser calls `sessionInventory.revoke("S2")` and browser B replays its next protected-route request
acceptanceCriteria.then: the revoke returns successfully; the session store no longer holds a record for S2; browser B's replay is refused as unauthenticated on the next request; the audit sink records exactly one `keycloak.session_inventory_revoked` event carrying the operation, a session id prefix no longer than eight characters, and the wall-clock timestamp

acceptanceCriteria.description: `revokeAllExceptCurrent()` invalidates every active project session for the caller other than the one making the call.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a caller with project sessions S1 (current), S2, S3
acceptanceCriteria.then: the return value is `2`; a subsequent `list()` returns exactly one row for S1 with `currentSession=true`; replays from S2 or S3 are refused as unauthenticated on their next request

acceptanceCriteria.description: An unauthenticated call to any `sessionInventory` operation refuses with `SESSION_INVENTORY_UNAUTHENTICATED` and no side effect.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a request with no verified session
acceptanceCriteria.when: any of the three operations is invoked
acceptanceCriteria.then: each call throws `SESSION_INVENTORY_UNAUTHENTICATED`; the project session store's records are unchanged; the audit sink records exactly one `keycloak.session_inventory_unauthenticated` event

acceptanceCriteria.description: `revoke(sessionId)` against a session id the caller does not own, or a session already invalidated, refuses without a side effect.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an authenticated caller and a `sessionId` naming a session belonging to a different principal or an already-invalidated session
acceptanceCriteria.then: the call throws `SESSION_INVENTORY_UNKNOWN_SESSION`; the session store is unchanged; the audit sink records exactly one `keycloak.session_inventory_unknown_session` event
